name: Kosmos Energy
outlook:
What Kosmos Energy says to expect

  • Full year 2026: capital expenditureFull year 2026 capital expenditure guidance of approximately $350 million is unchanged.
  • Full year 2026: net debtWith strong operational performance for the year and continued debt reduction, we are on track to achieve our ~20% net debt reduction target for 2026 with year-end net debt expected to be below $2.4 billion and leverage expected to fall towards 2.0x.
  • Full year 2026: Mauritania and Senegal LNG cargo liftingsFull year gross LNG cargo liftings are expected to be at the upper end of the 32-36 guidance range.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 2, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
